title: Committed Production Credentials & Client-Side Secrets Exposure
description: Live production database passwords, JWT signing secret, India Post CEPT credentials, MSG91 auth key, and live Razorpay keys were committed to git history. Multiple backend secrets are prefixed with VITE_ in frontend configuration, causing Vite to bundle them into public browser JavaScript.
impact: Complete compromise of backend database, identity token forgery, unauthorized access to shipping carrier accounts, and unauthorized API usage.
recommendation: Purge git history using git-filter-repo or BFG; immediately rotate all database, JWT, India Post, MSG91, and Razorpay credentials. Remove VITE_ prefix from all server-only keys and ensure .env is strictly ignored.

title: Hardcoded Plaintext Credentials & Client-Side Super Admin Backdoor
description: Frontend contains hardcoded plaintext password 'NIL@apl321' and a client-side offline bypass that provisions an active Super Admin session if the backend API is unreachable or fails.
impact: Any visitor can inspect browser JavaScript source maps, extract the master password, and gain client-side Super Admin UI access.
recommendation: Remove all hardcoded passwords, emergency bypasses, and client-side fallback sessions. Enforce server-side authentication exclusively via secure HttpOnly session cookies.

title: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation to OWNER via Admin Login API
description: The admin login route validates an emergency static passcode ('NIL@apl321' and OTP '123456'). If the user email does not exist in the database, it automatically creates a new User with role UserRole.OWNER.
impact: Remote unauthenticated attackers can self-provision root-level OWNER administrative accounts directly on the production database.
recommendation: Delete the emergency user-creation branch and static passcode validation in auth.py. Restrict owner registration to database seed scripts or secure CLI commands.

title: Complete Discard of Customer Contact & Delivery Address during Order Creation
description: The Order and Shipment SQLAlchemy models have no database columns or relationships for recipient name, phone, email, street address, city, state, or PIN code. Order placement calculates financial totals but drops all delivery information on the floor.
impact: Zero customer orders can be dispatched, shipped, or fulfilled. Every placed order is an unfulfillable financial record without a destination.
recommendation: Create a database migration adding an OrderAddress model or embedded address fields (recipient_name, phone, email, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, pincode) to the Order model and persist OrderCreate.shipping_address.

title: Missing API Reverse Proxy in Vercel Single-Page-Application Deployment
description: vercel.json defines a catch-all rewrite sending all paths (/(.*)) to /index.html without a preceding rewrite rule for /api/(.*) pointing to the FastAPI backend.
impact: When deployed to Vercel, all frontend fetch calls to /api/v1/* receive the HTML index page (HTTP 200) instead of JSON from FastAPI, breaking all live API communication in production.
recommendation: Add a priority rewrite rule in vercel.json mapping '/api/:match*' to the backend server URL or deploy backend independently with proper CORS and configured VITE_API_BASE_URL.

title: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA) in Order Retrieval Endpoint
description: In GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}, authorization checks verify if current_user.id == order.user_id. Because orders created without auth have user_id = None, current_user (with user_id != None) is rejected, but guest requests or tokenless access can read guest orders.
impact: Unauthorized actors can enumerate and read order details, pricing, and status across guest orders by iterating over integer/UUID order IDs.
recommendation: Enforce strict authenticated ownership checks. If guest order lookup is supported, require an unguessable cryptographically secure order tracking token or phone OTP verification.

title: Unhandled AttributeError Crash in Order Listing Endpoint
description: GET /api/v1/orders filters using Order.user_id == current_user.id. However, the SQLAlchemy Order model does not define a user_id column, causing SQLAlchemy to raise an AttributeError / InvalidRequestError resulting in an HTTP 500 error.
impact: Authenticated customers cannot view their order history; the customer portal crashes with HTTP 500.
recommendation: Add ForeignKey('users.id', nullable=True) to Order model and generate an Alembic migration.

title: Admin & Super Admin Panels Completely Decoupled from Backend Database
description: The administrative panels read from and write to browser localStorage keys ('apollo_products', 'apollo_orders') rather than calling FastAPI REST APIs. Database orders created via backend API never appear in the admin UI, and price/stock changes in admin never reach PostgreSQL.
impact: Administrators operate on an isolated client-side mock store while real customers place orders against PostgreSQL. Critical state bifurcation.
recommendation: Refactor Admin and Super Admin components to call authenticated FastAPI endpoints for products, inventory, orders, and configuration.

title: Customer Account Creation Inverts Permissions to Staff Role
description: Upon phone OTP verification for new users, the backend creates a User record with role=UserRole.SUPPORT because UserRole enum in models/auth.py lacks a CUSTOMER role.
impact: Every customer registering via phone OTP is granted an internal staff role (SUPPORT), exposing internal endpoints intended for customer support agents.
recommendation: Add UserRole.CUSTOMER = 'customer' to UserRole enum and default all public registrations to CUSTOMER.

title: Simulated Razorpay Orders in Production & Swallowed Webhook Failures
description: create_payment_order falls back to returning a mock order ID ('order_' + uuid) when Razorpay credentials are invalid or client initialization fails. Webhook handler catches all exceptions and returns HTTP 200 without reprocessing or dead-letter queues.
impact: Customers are presented with simulated payment screens in production, and corrupted webhook deliveries are acknowledged to Razorpay as successful without updating order status.
recommendation: Raise an explicit 503 Bad Gateway if payment gateway is unreachable in production. Return HTTP 400/500 on webhook verification failures so Razorpay retries delivery.

title: Silent Fallback to Default Product in Catalog Card Component
description: ProductCard defaults fallback lookups to products[0] (Solar Clamp) whenever matching attributes are missing or undefined during card click.
impact: Customers clicking or adding an accessory or bracket are silently switched to the clamp product, causing wrong items in cart and checkout.
recommendation: Remove fallback to products[0]. Require explicit product ID matching; throw or display an error if product is not found.

title: Unrouted In-Memory Product Detail View Broken on Refresh or Direct Navigation
description: Product Detail Page view state is stored solely in React useState (selectedProduct). Direct linking, browser refresh, or back button navigation clears state and redirects to the home catalog.
impact: Customers cannot share product links, bookmark items, or refresh the page without losing their place. Severe SEO and conversion penalty.
recommendation: Migrate to path-based routing (e.g. /product/:slug) using React Router or Next.js App Router.

title: 50+ Backend Integration & Database Tests Skipped Due to Offline Test Container
description: All 50 integration tests require an active PostgreSQL instance at port 5433. During test runs, tests skip or fail if the Docker container is not active, leaving full-lifecycle APIs untested in CI.
impact: Critical regressions in database migrations, payment webhooks, and concurrency locks pass unnoticed in local testing.
recommendation: Configure a GitHub Actions service container for PostgreSQL 16 in CI, and provide an automatic SQLite in-memory fallback for local integration test execution.

title: Database Driver Inconsistency & SQLite DB Tracked in Git
description: Codebase alternates between asyncpg, psycopg2, and sqlite3 drivers. Local development runs on a committed SQLite file (backend/apollo_ecommerce.db), causing dialect divergences from PostgreSQL.
impact: PostgreSQL-specific types (JSONB, UUID, NUMERIC precision) behave differently between local and production environments.
recommendation: Add apollo_ecommerce.db to .gitignore. Standardize backend on asyncpg for async SQLAlchemy and run all testing environments against PostgreSQL.

title: Internal Server Exception Leakage in Order Placement API
description: In create_order, unexpected exceptions are formatted into the HTTP 500 response body as {'detail': f'Order placement failed: {str(e)}'}.
impact: Database query syntax, table names, and internal Python stack details are leaked to API callers.
recommendation: Catch unexpected exceptions, log full traceback server-side with structured error logging, and return a sanitized message: {'detail': 'An error occurred while processing your order.'}.

title: Inconsistent Frontend vs Backend COD Rounding Logic
description: Frontend CartContext rounds COD total using Math.ceil(prepaidTotal * 1.025) without ₹5 multiple snapping, while backend applies Decimal rounding to nearest ₹5 multiple.
impact: Discrepancy of ₹1 to ₹4 between the price displayed on the checkout button and the actual final order amount charged by the server.
recommendation: Unify COD calculation formulas; fetch authoritative quote from /api/v1/checkout/quote before rendering payment options.

title: Massive Production JS Bundle Exceeding Performance Budgets
description: Production Vite build generates a single monolithic JavaScript bundle exceeding 3.1 MB uncompressed (including exceljs at 940 KB and lucide-react full icon suite).
impact: Slow initial page loads (LCP > 3.8s) on mobile 3G/4G networks, causing high bounce rates in tier-2/tier-3 regions.
recommendation: Configure dynamic code splitting in vite.config.ts; lazy-load admin dashboards, exceljs, and Lucide icons.

title: WCAG Color Contrast Disabled in Playwright Accessibility Suite
description: Axe accessibility test suite explicitly disables the 'color-contrast' rule to prevent test failures across steel grey buttons and low-contrast labels.
impact: Users with visual impairments cannot clearly perceive secondary text, button labels, and status badges; violates WCAG 2.1 AA.
recommendation: Update CSS custom properties to ensure text meets a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio and re-enable the color-contrast rule in a11y.spec.ts.

title: Administrative & Account Routes Exposed to Search Engine Indexation
description: robots.txt contains only 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' without Disallow directives for /admin, /super-admin, /account, or /checkout.
impact: Search engine bots attempt to index private admin screens and session-dependent checkout routes, diluting SEO crawl budget.
recommendation: Add Disallow rules for /admin, /super-admin, /checkout, and /account in robots.txt.

title: High-Severity Security Vulnerability in Image Processing Dependency
description: npm audit reports 7 vulnerabilities, including 1 High severity vulnerability in sharp <=0.35.4-rc.0 leading to remote denial of service or memory corruption.
impact: Potential crash or vulnerability in media processing pipeline.
recommendation: Run npm update sharp --save or migrate to latest secure release.

title: Secret Scanning & Audit Failures Silenced in CI/CD Pipeline
description: GitHub Actions workflow marks Gitleaks secret scanning and npm audit steps with continue-on-error: true, allowing builds with leaked secrets or vulnerable dependencies to pass.
impact: Developers are not blocked when committing exposed keys or vulnerable libraries.
recommendation: Remove continue-on-error: true from secret scanning and high-severity vulnerability checks.

title: Hidden Admin Trigger Tooltip Visible in User-Facing Header & Footer
description: Double-clicking the brand logo navigates to /super-admin, and the logo DOM element has title='Double-click for Super Admin', advertising internal controls to public users.
impact: Unprofessional presentation and invitation for malicious actors to attempt login brute-forcing.
recommendation: Remove double-click admin navigation and title tooltips from public consumer components.

title: 50 Ruff Formatting Warnings and 17 Mypy Static Type Errors in Backend Codebase
description: Static code analysis reveals 50 Ruff style/import violations and 17 Mypy static type errors, including missing attributes and type mismatches in models and endpoints.
impact: Increased code maintenance burden and risk of runtime TypeErrors during edge case execution.
recommendation: Run ruff check --fix backend/ and resolve all 17 Mypy type annotations.
